005package org.wpilib.fields;
006
007import io.avaje.jsonb.Json;
008import java.util.Objects;
009import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose3d;
010
011/** Represents a field tag's metadata. */
012@Json
013public final class FieldTag {
014  @Json.Property("ID")
015  private final int m_id;
016
017  @Json.Property("pose")
018  private final Pose3d m_pose;
019
020  /**
021   * Constructs a field tag.
022   *
023   * @param ID The tag's ID.
024   * @param pose The tag's pose.
025   */
026  @SuppressWarnings("ParameterName")
027  @Json.Creator
028  public FieldTag(int ID, Pose3d pose) {
029    m_id = ID;
030    m_pose = Objects.requireNonNull(pose, "pose");
031  }
032
033  /**
034   * Returns the tag's ID.
035   *
036   * @return The tag's ID.
037   */
038  public int getID() {
039    return m_id;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Returns the tag's pose.
044   *
045   * @return The tag's pose.
046   */
047  public Pose3d getPose() {
048    return m_pose;
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
053    return obj instanceof FieldTag tag && m_id == tag.m_id && m_pose.equals(tag.m_pose);
054  }
055
056  @Override
057  public int hashCode() {
058    return Objects.hash(m_id, m_pose);
059  }
060
061  @Override
062  public String toString() {
063    return "FieldTag(ID: " + m_id + ", pose: " + m_pose + ")";
064  }
065}
